class_hint: Continuous gentle gas bubbles in liquid or wet foam—not solid scraping or crushing.
noun_cues: air + water/soapy water; bath bomb; effervescent tablet; plastic spheres (liquid inside); foam fizz—not dry tools or ear friction.

class_hint: Directed airflow or breath on a surface—no sustained solid–solid slide.
noun_cues: mouth; lips; breath; fan; straw; air stream on mic/ear/skin—not nails/brushes/knives.

class_hint: Heated oily food micro-pops from cooking—not dry flame crackle alone.
noun_cues: hot oil; food on pan; cooking surface; sizzling food—not candle/wick alone.

class_hint: Flame, combustion, or dry thermal crackle—not candy pop or package snap.
noun_cues: flame; candle; wick; fire; embers; dry thermal source—not bubble wrap or gel pod.

class_hint: Sharp discrete micro-pops (candy, bubble-wrap, gel-pod)—not continuous crackle or crush.
noun_cues: bubble wrap; popping candy; gel pod; plastic pod snap; crisp packet pop—not brush strokes or spoon in cup.

class_hint: Object spins in place with rotation/mechanical whirr—not flip of pages/cards.
noun_cues: spinner; wheel; rotating gear; spinning object on axis—not cards/pages flipping.

class_hint: Repeated flip/turn cyclic contacts (cards, pages)—not continuous rotation hum.
noun_cues: cards; pages; book; flipping sheets—not spinner/wheel/gear.

class_hint: Regular mechanical tick from clock/timer escapement—not keyboard typing.
noun_cues: clock; timer; metronome; wall clock—self-sounding; object often null—not keyboard keys.

class_hint: Metal/glass/crystal parts of the prop itself lightly colliding or ringing—object-intrinsic crisp shimmer (like crackling is flame-intrinsic); not tool-on-surface scrape, pour/spill, or shaken-container rattle.
noun_cues: wind chime; bell; metal/glass/crystal ornament; hanging pendants; chain tinkle—sound from the object's own rigid parts—NOT bead/sequin pour or spill; NOT jar/bead shake; NOT nail/brush on mesh or mic (friction).

class_hint: Sustained solid–solid slide, bristle stroke, scratch, or roll—not peel/cut, crush, stir-in-cup, wet smear, or modeling-pack peel/scrape.
noun_cues: nails; hair; bristles; brush; fabric; fur; dried flower; cotton swab slide; wood stick slide on surface/mic/ear—NOT knife/scissors/modeling pack peel/spoon in bowl/slime smash.

class_hint: Short discrete impacts: tap, key press, drop—NOT sustained slide or crush.
noun_cues: tapping finger; keyboard keys; dropped beads/object; light discrete impacts—not sustained brush/hair slide or peeling.

class_hint: Edge/tool removes material; blade cuts, tears, pierces, or scrapes layer off—including modeling pack / face mask peel or scrape from ear or mic—NOT whole-object crush or stir-in-container.
noun_cues: knife; scissors; blade; needle; metal tool; tweezers; gloved hand peeling edge; modeling pack; dried mask on silicone ear; ear-scrape tool removing layer—NOT jelly/slime/orbeez crush; NOT spoon stirring ice.

class_hint: Pressure deforms, stretches, or breaks a solid—crinkle, crush, smash—NOT blade peel, wet wipe, or stir inside cup.
noun_cues: slime; jelly; floam; orbeez; floral foam; popcorn; crinkling paper under press; foam block crush; stretchy goo pull—NOT knife/peeling pack; NOT cream wipe on ear; NOT spoon in bowl.

class_hint: Whisper, chew/crunch, or lick—oral cavity only; no external tool on mic.
noun_cues: mouth; tongue; teeth; lips; whisper; chewing food—no external tool subject.

class_hint: Liquid or particle stream between containers or from nozzle—NOT smear on fixed surface.
noun_cues: pouring liquid; spray bottle; nozzle; stream between containers; water pour—NOT cloth/cream smear on ear surface.

class_hint: Wet/sticky medium smeared, wiped, or adhered on a surface—NOT dry modeling-pack peel/scrape, NOT in-cup stirring.
noun_cues: cream; gel; aloe; lotion; cloth; cotton pad; tape; adhesive sticker; wipe on ear/mic/skin; spatula on paint stick/unstick—NOT modeling pack peel/scrape off ear; NOT ice/spoon in bowl; NOT slime ball smash.

class_hint: Stir or shake contents inside a container—NOT external slide on mic fur alone.
noun_cues: spoon; stick; ice cubes in glass; aloe in bowl; foam beads in container; beads in jar—agitation INSIDE vessel—NOT hair brush on mic; NOT peel on ear.

class_hint: Pen/stylus line-making or brush moving paint on a surface—not ear cleaning friction.
noun_cues: pen; pencil; marker; stylus; paintbrush with paint on paper/canvas—not ear cleaning nails/brushes on silicone ear.
